message: Verdant 15.4.4 repairs the VCC package structure so Editor tools compile from Packages and restores VerdantRoleAuthority required by the VRCLinking bridge.
notes: Adds the matching UdonSharp assembly registration asset for Verdant.Runtime.
Restores VerdantRoleAuthority inside the VPM Runtime package with its original Unity GUID.
Keeps the collision-proof supporter scroll, shared clock and Main Board version installer.
Fixes the missing Tools > Verdant Board menu caused by package scripts not belonging to an assembly.
